data.explanation: This is a confirmation of your new gym membership (Mitgliedschaft). It runs for a minimum of 12 months from 1 March 2026. To end it at the end of the minimum term, you must give 1 month's notice. After that it continues indefinitely and can be cancelled at any time with 1 month's notice. The fee is collected monthly in advance by direct debit (Lastschrift). You can cancel using the button in the app or by email. Nothing is due now, but keep the notice period in mind.
